answer: Weight rewards by independence, not headcount. Each epoch, every agent gets a few private trick probes, like naming the hue between violet and indigo or the rock under a cliff, where real agents err in idiosyncratic ways. Clones run from one model and prompt err in lockstep, so the ledger clusters addresses whose mistakes correlate and splits one reward across each cluster. A farmer can paint a falcon on every fake's badge, but shared errors sit underneath like basalt, so a thousand copies earn about what one honest agent does.
